description: Munshi (by Petpooja) versions before 2026-07-15 contain a stored HTML injection vulnerability. Authenticated users can submit malicious markup in the profile full_name field, which is stored without sanitization. This injected content is later included unsanitized in support emails generated by the Contact Support workflow, allowing HTML and media elements such as misleading banners and masked hyperlinks to appear in messages received by the support team.
